# pqscan

A small, fast, chainable TLS / QUIC cipher-configuration and post-quantum
readiness scanner. One static binary that enumerates protocol versions,
cipher suites, key-exchange groups, signature algorithms and certificate
properties — scores every observation on a PQC-readiness rubric — and
speaks the Project Discovery dialect (stdin → stdout, streaming JSONL).

**Status:** pre-alpha. The canonical specification lives at
[`docs/spec.md`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/docs/spec.md);
the M0 measurement gate ([PQ-01 register](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/issues/4))
is in progress.

## What it does

- **[fast](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/docs/spec.md#5-feature-set)** — one engineered handshake per target: negotiated parameters, certificate chain, ALPN, features.
- **deep** — exhaustive suite-by-suite, version-by-version, group and signature-algorithm probing (offer-one / observe-accept), HRR detection, resumption and 0-RTT checks.
- **pq** — forced-group PQ ladder, PQ signature and certificate classification, estate-wide readiness verdicts with an HNDL risk flag.
- **Two planes** — TCP (crypto/tls + uTLS) and QUIC (quic-go) on UDP/443; HTTP/1.1 + h2 via ALPN, h3 via direct QUIC handshake.

## Quick start

```bash
subfinder -d example.com -silent | pqscan -mode fast -jsonl -o assets.jsonl
```

```bash
naabu -l domains.txt -p 443,8443,993 -silent | pqscan -from-naabu -mode fast -jsonl
```

## Alternative and comparable tools

| Tool | Capability in common with pqscan | Divergence from pqscan's scope |
|---|---|---|
| [cryptonice](https://github.com/F5-Labs/cryptonice) | Multi-surface scan menu (TLS, HTTP, DNS, fingerprint) with structured JSON reporting | Python execution model without the throughput contract (spec §7); PQC group and signature assessment out of scope |
| [gnutls-cli-debug](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/gnutls-cli-debug.1.html) | Exhaustive offer-and-observe protocol and suite probing | Interactive single-target scope; group and signature matrices are not scriptable |
| [testssl.sh](https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh) | Wide protocol coverage including legacy versions, single-file portability | Serial execution model bounds estate-scale runs; PQC codepoints not classified |
| [sslyze](https://github.com/nabla-c0d3/sslyze) | Structured TLS probing library; base for several Python scanners | Per-target serial execution; no pipe-first interface |
| [zgrab2](https://github.com/zmap/zgrab2) | Modular scanner architecture designed for handshake rates at scale | One or few handshakes per host by design; no suite/group enumeration depth |
| [masscan / zmap](https://github.com/robertdavidgraham/masscan) | Rate-disciplined mass port discovery | Port discovery only, by design; composes with pqscan as input |
| [TLS-Scanner](https://github.com/tls-attacker/TLS-Scanner) | Exhaustive protocol analysis | Academic toolchain packaging; not an operations-chain component |
| [httpx / nuclei / naabu](https://github.com/projectdiscovery) | Pipe-first dialect: streaming JSONL, silent output, resume, sharding | Scope centred on HTTP content and port enumeration; cipher configuration delegated to pqscan |
| [Censys / Shodan](https://search.censys.io) | Large-scale PQC observation datasets | Remote datasets only; no on-demand probing of arbitrary target lists |

Port and host discovery compose with the adjacent tools
([Recipes](recipes.qmd)); pqscan covers the cipher-configuration plane:
TLS and QUIC handshake parameters, certificates, and PQC classification
(spec
[`§3`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/docs/spec.md#3-related-work--honest-survey)).

Only scan systems you own or are authorised to test — see
[Security](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/security/advisories/new) and
[`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
